$comment: Provenance record for the STOCK placeholder photography (D-20, option c).
These are stand-ins so the site can be shown and reviewed with real imagery instead of
grey boxes. They are NOT Apex's work, and nothing on the site claims they are — every
alt text below describes the photo generically, and each slot carries `stock: true` in
src/content/images.ts so `npm run preflight` warns about them before any real launch.
Source: Unsplash. The Unsplash License permits commercial use, free of charge, with no
attribution required (attribution is appreciated, and the photographer is recorded below
regardless). It does NOT permit compiling a competing stock-photo service, which is not
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: six months from now, nobody will remember where a JPEG in
public/ came from or whether it was licensed. Provenance for third-party media belongs
in the repo, next to the media.
Re-download everything with: npm run stock:fetch
TODO(D-20): every entry here is a placeholder. Replacing one with real Apex photography

$imageFields.slot: the image-manifest slot id in src/content/images.ts this fills
$imageFields.ratio: aspect ratio the file is cropped to — MUST match the slot's ratio or the swap shifts layout
$imageFields.widths: the widths downloaded, emitted as a srcset (AC-9.5)
$imageFields.describes: what the photo actually shows — this becomes the alt text, and it must not claim the work is Apex's
